author: manuelmo922
quote: Wait for a sale and do not day 1 this. For what we have waited for to what we received, this game is clearly not what everyone hoped it would be. I can clearly see some good features like detail, the maps, the cars, even the task are detail in of itself, but the forced down your throat Bonnie and Clyde story is really just a toxic relationship of two people. And I don't mean this based on the criminal aspect. It feels like there was no real story guidance from anyone as good as Dan Houser's writing, and Jason's character feels like an after thought. Since the last parts of RDR 2 with John Marston and building his house, it feels like many of those moments gave birth to the very beginning components of this game and it feels half baked in many ways. I know these "chores" or task are not the entire game; however what the missions and story entirely feel like are just a very boring and lackluster experience that no journalist has the balls to say despite what it is that they all probably feel in fear of falling out of rockstars graces when all their fans have done so with Rockstar after this game.
